items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ve been to Gore’s home about 5 or 6 times. He’s marvelous.

ctx.x: Did you find any of the – of all the Presidents you played before and all that situations you’ve been in, who did you find that you felt, or what ones of them you felt were really connecting with the music?

Kennedy, for instance. He had started a program that when the kid learned to read from left to right, they were going to learn something about music. Because I was on the panel, Mercer Ellington and I. It never got off the ground, but I know he was 100% into that. Now, the current President – I’ve been down there several times for Clinton. He’s really into it. He’s doing – and Gore also. I’ve been to Gore’s home about 5 or 6 times. He’s marvelous. And Tipper’s a drummer, you know.
